cities.name: Suva
cities.tagline: Harbour capital of markets, colonial streets, and rainforest parks
cities.general: Suva is Fiji's political and cultural capital, with a working harbour, the Fiji Museum, Thurston Gardens, and easy access to Colo-i-Suva forest walks.
activities: Visit the Fiji Museum and Thurston Gardens
Walk the harbourfront and municipal market
Explore nearby beaches toward Pacific Harbour
tips: Weekday traffic is heavy around Victoria Parade

cities.name: Nadi
cities.tagline: Gateway town for the Mamanucas, highlands, and west-coast temples
cities.general: Nadi is Fiji's main international gateway, with the Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple, Denarau marina, and transfers to the Mamanuca and Yasawa islands.
activities: Visit the Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple
Transfer to island resorts from Denarau
See the Garden of the Sleeping Giant
tips: Airport days are busy — book transfers
Temple dress should cover shoulders and knees

cities.name: Lautoka
cities.tagline: Sugar-port city and west-Viti Levu base for highland roads
cities.general: Lautoka is Fiji's second city, a working sugar port with markets, colonial streets, and a practical base for Koroyanitu and the northern highlands.
activities: Walk Churchill Park and the market
tips: A 4WD helps for highland roads after rain
Markets are busiest in the morning

cities.name: Savusavu
cities.tagline: Vanua Levu harbour town of hot springs, reefs, and yacht moorings
cities.general: Savusavu sits on a deep harbour on Vanua Levu, with hot springs, snorkel reefs, copra-town streets, and a slower alternative to the Viti Levu circuit.
tips: Flights and ferries fill in peak season

cities.name: Levuka
cities.tagline: UNESCO port town on Ovalau with wooden streets and harbour hills
cities.general: Levuka is Fiji's first colonial capital, a UNESCO-listed timber port with a steep green backdrop, historic storefronts, and a compact harbour walk.
tips: The ferry from Suva can be weather-dependent

cities.name: Pacific Harbour
cities.tagline: South-coast adventure hub for rivers, reefs, and Beqa crossings
cities.general: Pacific Harbour is a planned south-coast town used as a base for shark dives, river trips, cultural shows, and Beqa Lagoon crossings.
activities: Join a Beqa Lagoon dive or snorkel
tips: Resort prices are higher than Suva

cities.name: Labasa
cities.tagline: Northern sugar town and Vanua Levu inland service hub
cities.general: Labasa is the main town of northern Vanua Levu, a hot sugar-cane centre with markets and access to hinterland villages and the Natewa coast.
tips: Roads flood in the wet season
Services thin out quickly outside town

cities.name: Port Moresby
cities.tagline: Harbour capital of parliament, museums, and Varirata day trips
cities.general: Port Moresby is PNG's capital on Fairfax Harbour, with the National Museum, Parliament Haus, craft markets, and the nearest national-park walks at Varirata.
activities: Visit Parliament Haus and the National Museum
Walk Ela Beach at quieter hours
tips: Heat is intense at sea level

cities.name: Lae
cities.tagline: Morobe port city and gateway to the Highlands Highway
cities.general: Lae is PNG's industrial port and the usual start of the Highlands Highway, with botanic gardens, a working harbour, and access to Salamaua and the Markham.
activities: Visit the Rainforest Habitat or botanic gardens
Day-trip toward Salamaua if conditions allow
tips: The highway needs a prepared vehicle and local advice

cities.name: Mount Hagen
cities.tagline: Western Highlands market town for culture shows and mountain roads
cities.general: Mount Hagen is the main Western Highlands town, known for produce markets, sing-sing culture, and access to high valleys and Mount Giluwe country.
activities: Time a trip for the cultural show
tips: Roadblocks can occur — travel with local knowledge
Show weeks book out months ahead

cities.name: Madang
cities.tagline: North-coast harbour town of reefs, islands, and wartime wrecks
cities.general: Madang sits on a coral-fringed harbour with nearby islands, snorkel reefs, and a slower north-coast pace than Lae or Port Moresby.
tips: Dive operators need booking in peak months

cities.name: Goroka
cities.tagline: Eastern Highlands town of coffee, museums, and the Goroka Show
cities.general: Goroka is a cool highland town on the highway, with a museum, coffee country, and one of PNG's best-known cultural shows each September.
activities: Time a stay for the Goroka Show

cities.name: Alotau
cities.tagline: Milne Bay town for island hops, WWII sites, and whale season
cities.general: Alotau is the Milne Bay provincial capital, a jumping-off point for island communities, wartime history, and seasonal whale watching.
tips: Cash is useful on outer islands

cities.name: Kokopo
cities.tagline: East New Britain town under the Rabaul volcanoes
cities.general: Kokopo replaced Rabaul as the provincial centre after the 1994 eruptions and is the base for Tavurvur views, hot springs, and the old Rabaul harbour.
activities: See hot springs and black-sand beaches
tips: Ash and heat are intense near the crater
Hire a local driver for the caldera

cities.name: Wewak
cities.tagline: Sepik-coast town and gateway to river communities
cities.general: Wewak is the coastal gateway to the Sepik, with a long beach, wartime history, and boat connections toward river villages and markets.

cities.name: Port Vila
cities.tagline: Harbour capital for markets, Mele Cascades, and Efate loops
cities.general: Port Vila wraps a sheltered harbour with markets, waterfront restaurants, and day trips to Mele Cascades, Hideaway Island, and Chief Roi Mata sites.
activities: Walk or swim at Hideaway Island
tips: ATMs can run low on weekends
Reef shoes help on coral beaches

cities.name: Luganville
cities.tagline: Espiritu Santo town for blue holes, wrecks, and Champagne Beach
cities.general: Luganville is Santo's service town, the base for Million Dollar Point, SS President Coolidge dives, blue holes, and the road to Champagne Beach.
activities: Arrange a Coolidge dive if certified
tips: The east-coast road is rough in places

cities.name: Lenakel
cities.tagline: Tanna west-coast town and gateway to Mount Yasur
cities.general: Lenakel is Tanna's main west-coast town, used as a staging point for Yasur volcano, kava bars, and villages on the ash plains.
tips: 4WD is needed for the volcano road

cities.name: Honiara
cities.tagline: Guadalcanal capital of markets, WWII ridges, and Mataniko walks
cities.general: Honiara stretches along Guadalcanal's north coast, with the Central Market, wartime ridges, Mataniko Falls, and boat links to other islands.
tips: WWII sites are spread out — hire a guide

cities.name: Gizo
cities.tagline: Western Province lagoon town for wrecks, islands, and diving
cities.general: Gizo is the main town of the New Georgia group, a dive and island-hopping base near Kennedy Island, wrecks, and barrier reefs.
activities: Visit Skull Island with a guide
tips: Cash is more useful than cards
Book dives before you fly in

cities.name: Auki
cities.tagline: Malaita harbour town for markets and bushland roads
cities.general: Auki is Malaita's provincial centre, a harbour town with markets and access to inland villages and coastal passages.

cities.name: Munda
cities.tagline: New Georgia lagoon town for wrecks, bonefishing, and WWII airfields
cities.general: Munda sits on Roviana Lagoon with a wartime airfield, wreck dives, and a quieter Western Province alternative to Gizo.
tips: Flights are small and book out

cities.name: Noumea
cities.tagline: Lagoon capital of museums, beaches, and the Tjibaou centre
cities.general: Nouméa is a Pacific-French capital on a UNESCO lagoon, with Anse Vata, the Tjibaou Cultural Centre, markets, and day trips to Rivière Bleue.
activities: Swim at Anse Vata or Baie des Citrons
tips: Book Île des Pins flights early

cities.name: Kone
cities.tagline: West-coast town near the Heart of Voh and mining country
cities.general: Koné is a west-coast service town used as a base for the Heart of Voh mangrove heart, coastal roads, and inland ranges.
activities: See the Heart of Voh by air or lookout

cities.name: Poindimie
cities.tagline: East-coast wet-tropics town for waterfalls and tribal stays
cities.general: Poindimié sits on the greener east coast, with rivers, tribal gîtes, and access to waterfalls and the Central Range.
tips: Rain is frequent on this coast

cities.name: We
cities.tagline: Lifou's main village for cliffs, caves, and Loyalty Island reefs
cities.general: Wé is the chief village of Lifou, with limestone cliffs, caves, vanilla, and a slower Loyalty Islands pace than Grande Terre.
tips: Flights from Nouméa book out in holidays

cities.name: Bourail
cities.tagline: West-coast town for Roche Percée, turtles, and surf beaches
cities.general: Bourail is the gateway to Roche Percée, La Roche Percée surf, and turtle-nesting beaches on the west coast.

cities.name: Papeete
cities.tagline: Tahiti harbour capital of markets, ferries, and island flights
cities.general: Papeete is the administrative heart of French Polynesia, with the municipal market, waterfront, ferry links, and the start of circle-island drives.
activities: Drive the circle island toward Point Venus
Catch an inter-island flight or ferry
tips: Pearl and market prices vary — compare

cities.name: Punaauia
cities.tagline: West-Tahiti lagoon town for museums and Faaa-side beaches
cities.general: Punaauia stretches along Tahiti's west lagoon with the Musée de Tahiti, lagoon swimming, and a residential alternative to central Papeete.
activities: See sunset along the west coast

cities.name: Uturoa
cities.tagline: Raiatea's main town and gateway to Taputapuatea
cities.general: Uturoa is Raiatea's port town, used for yacht charters, the sacred marae of Taputapuatea, and hops to Taha'a.

cities.name: Taiohae
cities.tagline: Nuku Hiva bay town and Marquesas jumping-off point
cities.general: Taiohae sits in a collapsed volcanic bay on Nuku Hiva, the usual first stop in the Marquesas for sculptors, ridges, and boat days.

cities.name: Fare
cities.tagline: Huahine's main village for lagoons, marae, and quiet roads
cities.general: Fare is the small port village of Huahine, with a lagoon, marae, and one of the Society Islands' least-developed main towns.
tips: Ferry days are the busy ones

cities.name: Apia
cities.tagline: Harbour capital for markets, Mount Vaea, and Robert Louis Stevenson
cities.general: Apia is Samoa's compact capital, with the fish market, waterfront, Vailima, and the Mount Vaea walk above the harbour.
activities: Day-trip to Piula or To Sua
tips: Sunday is a rest day in villages
Lavalava or covered knees at churches

cities.name: Salelologa
cities.tagline: Savai'i ferry town and start of the big-island loop
cities.general: Salelologa is the ferry arrival on Savai'i, a small service town used to start loops toward blowholes, lava fields, and rainforest fales.

cities.name: Pago Pago
cities.tagline: Deep-harbour town under Rainmaker Mountain
cities.general: Pago Pago occupies one of the Pacific's finest natural harbours, with tuna-port industry, ridge walks, and the National Park of American Samoa nearby.
activities: Ride or hike the Mount Alava tramway route
Visit the national park visitor centre
tips: The harbour can be rainy and humid
Tuna-cannery odour is part of town

cities.name: Tafuna
cities.tagline: Airport-side town for Tutuila services and west-island access
cities.general: Tafuna is the commercial and airport town of Tutuila, useful for services, car hire, and west-island beaches.
tips: Airport traffic spikes with Honolulu flights

cities.name: Nuku'alofa
cities.tagline: Waterfront capital of palaces, markets, and Tongatapu loops
cities.general: Nuku'alofa is Tonga's low-rise capital on Tongatapu, with the Royal Palace waterfront, Talamahu Market, and day loops to blowholes and Ha'amonga.
tips: Whales are a seasonal Vava'u trip, not here

cities.name: Neiafu
cities.tagline: Vava'u harbour town for whales, caves, and yacht moorings
cities.general: Neiafu sits on one of the Pacific's best yacht harbours and is the seasonal hub for humpback whales, Swallows Cave, and island hops.
activities: Join a whale-swim trip in season
tips: Whale season is roughly July to October

cities.name: Avarua
cities.tagline: Rarotonga's harbour town for markets, the Needle, and lagoon buses
cities.general: Avarua is the small main town of Rarotonga, with the Punanga Nui Market, the circle-island bus, and access to the Cross-Island Track.
tips: Scooters need care on wet roads

cities.name: Arutanga
cities.tagline: Aitutaki's village hub for the lagoon and One Foot Island
cities.general: Arutanga is Aitutaki's main village, the staging point for lagoon cruises, motu landings, and one of the Pacific's most famous turquoise lagoons.
tips: Cruises book out in peak season
Sun on the water is extreme

cities.name: Alofi
cities.tagline: Cliff-top capital for chasms, reefs, and limestone coastal walks
cities.general: Alofi is Niue's tiny capital on a raised coral island, with easy access to chasms, arches, and snorkel caves around the circumference road.
activities: Visit Matapa Chasm and Limu Pools
tips: Shops close early and on Sunday

cities.name: Koror
cities.tagline: Island-town hub for Rock Islands, reefs, and Jellyfish Lake
cities.general: Koror is Palau's main town and marina hub, the base for Rock Islands day boats, Jellyfish Lake, and World Heritage lagoon trips.
activities: Visit Jellyfish Lake with a permit
tips: Boat days sell out — book ahead
Jellyfish Lake has a visitor cap
Sun and glare on the water are intense

cities.name: Melekeok
cities.tagline: Babeldaob village beside the hillside capital at Ngerulmud
cities.general: Melekeok is the Babeldaob village nearest Palau's planned capital complex at Ngerulmud, with bai meeting houses and east-coast forest.
activities: See the Capitol complex at Ngerulmud

cities.name: Hagatna
cities.tagline: Historic capital of the plaza, latte stones, and the Hagåtña River
cities.general: Hagåtña is Guam's small historic capital, with the plaza, Dulce Nombre de Maria Cathedral, Latte Stone Park, and the start of cliff-top views.
activities: See the cliff-line toward Two Lovers Point
Explore Chamorro Village on Wednesday nights
tips: Tumon hotels are a short drive away

cities.name: Tamuning
cities.tagline: Tumon-bay hotel strip for reefs, shopping, and cliff walks
cities.general: Tamuning includes Tumon Bay, Guam's main hotel and reef-snorkel strip, with easy access to Two Lovers Point and north-island parks.
tips: Hotel beach is busy at midday
Rental cars make the north coast easy

cities.name: Garapan
cities.tagline: Saipan's main strip for beaches, WWII sites, and Mount Tapochau
cities.general: Garapan is Saipan's tourism and service strip, with Micro Beach, American Memorial Park, and access to Tapochau and the north-island cliffs.
tips: A car is the practical way around
Some cliff sites are sobering memorials

cities.name: Kolonia
cities.tagline: Pohnpei's harbour town for Nan Madol, waterfalls, and Sokehs Rock
cities.general: Kolonia is Pohnpei's main town, the usual base for Nan Madol, Kepirohi Falls, pepper farms, and the Sokehs Rock climb.
tips: Rain is frequent — trails get slick
Boat access to Nan Madol depends on tide

cities.name: Palikir
cities.tagline: Hilltop national capital above Pohnpei's harbour
cities.general: Palikir is the planned national capital in the hills behind Kolonia, a quiet administrative campus rather than a visitor strip.
activities: Use as a quiet inland stop
tips: Return to Kolonia for food and lodging

cities.name: Weno
cities.tagline: Chuuk's main island town and wreck-diving gateway
cities.general: Weno is the main island of Chuuk Lagoon, the staging point for the famous WWII wreck dives and a compact island-town base.
tips: Dives are advanced and need booking

cities.name: Majuro
cities.tagline: Long atoll capital of the lagoon road, Laura Beach, and Alele
cities.general: Majuro is a narrow atoll capital stretched along a lagoon road, with Alele Museum, the downtown strip, and the drive to Laura Beach.
tips: The road is the island — allow time

cities.name: Bairiki
cities.tagline: South Tarawa islet of government, causeways, and lagoon life
cities.general: Bairiki is the government islet of South Tarawa, linked by causeways to Betio and Bonriki, with maneaba, WWII relics nearby, and dense atoll life.
tips: The causeway is busy and hot

cities.name: London
cities.tagline: Kiritimati village hub for bonefish flats and seabirds
cities.general: London is the main village on Kiritimati (Christmas Island), a remote Line Islands base for bonefishing, birds, and vast lagoon flats.
activities: See the lagoon edge at low tide
tips: Bring more cash than you expect

cities.name: Yaren
cities.tagline: District capital on a raised phosphate island
cities.general: Yaren is Nauru's de facto capital district, with government buildings, the airport, and access to Command Ridge and Buada Lagoon.
tips: A car or scooter covers the island in a day

cities.name: Funafuti
cities.tagline: Atoll capital on a thin motu between lagoon and ocean
cities.general: Funafuti is Tuvalu's capital atoll, a narrow strip of houses, the airport-as-park, and boat access to the Funafuti Conservation Area.
activities: Visit the philatelic bureau if open

cities.name: Mata-Utu
cities.tagline: Uvea waterfront capital for the cathedral, lagoon, and crater lakes
cities.general: Mata-Utu is the capital of Wallis, with a waterfront cathedral, royal palace precinct, and access to Lake Lalolalo and the lagoon.
tips: Flights via Nouméa or Nadi are limited
A car is the easy way around

cities.name: Kingston
cities.tagline: Georgian Kingston and Arthur's Vale on a Pacific pine island
cities.general: Kingston is Norfolk Island's historic capital, a UNESCO-listed Georgian precinct of convict buildings, pines, and ocean lawns.
activities: See the cemetery by the sea
tips: Wind can be strong on the southern lawns

parks.name: Bouma National Heritage Park
parks.tagline: Taveuni rainforest, coastal walks, and Tavoro falls
parks.summary: Bouma covers much of eastern Taveuni with the Lavena Coastal Walk, Tavoro waterfalls, and village-managed rainforest.

parks.name: Koroyanitu National Heritage Park
parks.tagline: West-Viti Levu highland park above Abaca and Lautoka
parks.summary: Koroyanitu is a village-managed highland park of ridges, cloud forest, and views from the west-Viti Levu escarpment.

parks.name: Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park
parks.tagline: Wind-carved dunes and archaeological sites on the Coral Coast
parks.summary: Fiji's first national park protects coastal dunes, burial sites, and a short walk above the Sigatoka River mouth.

parks.name: Colo-i-Suva Forest Park
parks.tagline: Mahogany forest and swimming holes 15 minutes from Suva
parks.summary: Colo-i-Suva is a compact forestry park of pools, short trails, and rainforest birds on Suva's doorstep.

parks.name: Varirata National Park
parks.tagline: Sogeri-plateau forest and lookouts above Port Moresby
parks.summary: Varirata is the closest national park to Port Moresby, with Raggiana bird-of-paradise habitat, lookouts, and short plateau walks.

parks.name: Owen Stanley Ranges / Kokoda
parks.tagline: Wartime mountain crossing between Port Moresby and Popondetta
parks.summary: The Owen Stanley Ranges hold the Kokoda Track, high rainforest, village communities, and one of the Pacific's most demanding historic walks.

parks.name: Vatthe Conservation Area
parks.tagline: Santo west-coast forest and flying-fox river country
parks.summary: Vatthe protects lowland forest and river habitat on Espiritu Santo's west coast, with village-guided walks.

parks.name: Yasur / Lake Siwi area
parks.tagline: Live ash-plain volcano and the acid lake below Tanna's crater
parks.summary: The Yasur area is a constantly active cinder cone with a visitor crater rim, ash plains, and Lake Siwi in the old caldera.

parks.name: East Rennell / Lake Tegano
parks.tagline: World Heritage lake island at the south of Rennell
parks.summary: East Rennell protects Lake Tegano, the Pacific's largest island lake, with forest, endemic birds, and a remote World Heritage community.

parks.name: Parc Provincial de la Riviere Bleue
parks.tagline: Blue-water river, giant kaori, and cagou forest near Nouméa
parks.summary: Rivière Bleue is Grande Terre's best-known park, with a drowned kaori, cagou habitat, and still blue water under the southern ranges.

parks.name: Parc des Grandes Fougeres
parks.tagline: Tree-fern forest on the central range above Bourail
parks.summary: Grandes Fougères protects humid forest and giant ferns in the central range, with walking tracks above the west-coast plains.

parks.name: Te Fa'aiti Territorial Park
parks.tagline: Papenoo-valley rainforest on Tahiti's east side
parks.summary: Te Fa'aiti covers a slice of the Papenoo interior, with river gorges, rainforest, and 4WD access from the east coast.

parks.name: Fautaua Valley
parks.tagline: Waterfall valley above Papeete
parks.summary: Fautaua is the closest mountain walk to Papeete, a permit valley leading to a high waterfall under the Orohena massif.

parks.name: Lake Lanoto'o National Park
parks.tagline: Crater-lake walk in the hills above Apia
parks.summary: Lake Lanoto'o is a volcanic crater lake reached by a muddy highland track, with endemic birds and cool air above the capital.

parks.name: O Le Pupu Pu'e National Park
parks.tagline: South-coast lava tubes, lookouts, and rainforest
parks.summary: O Le Pupu Pu'e runs from the central ridge to the south coast, with a lookout walk, coastal lava, and Togitogiga nearby.

parks.name: National Park of American Samoa
parks.tagline: Rainforest ridges, Pola Island, and Ofu beach units
parks.summary: The National Park of American Samoa protects Tutuila ridges, the Pola sea cliffs, and separate Ofu and Ta'u units with some of the territory's best reefs.

parks.name: 'Eua National Park
parks.tagline: Clifftop rainforest on Tonga's oldest island
parks.summary: 'Eua National Park covers a slice of the island's eastern cliffs, with lookouts, birds, and short forest walks above the trench.

parks.name: Mount Talau National Park
parks.tagline: Short summit walk above Neiafu harbour
parks.summary: Mount Talau is a compact park above Vava'u's harbour, with a short climb to island and lagoon views.

parks.name: Takitumu Conservation Area
parks.tagline: Inland Rarotonga forest for kakerori and ridge walks
parks.summary: Takitumu is a community conservation area on Rarotonga's southeast interior, protecting kakerori and the start of inland trails.

parks.name: Huvalu Forest Conservation Area
parks.tagline: Largest forest remnant on the world's smallest republic
parks.summary: Huvalu protects a large share of Niue's remaining coastal and interior forest, with birds, caves, and guided access.

parks.name: Rock Islands Southern Lagoon
parks.tagline: World Heritage mushroom islets, lakes, and reefs
parks.summary: The Rock Islands Southern Lagoon is Palau's signature seascape of limestone islets, marine lakes, and coral gardens reached only by boat.

parks.name: War in the Pacific National Historical Park
parks.tagline: Asan and Agat invasion beaches and ridge guns
parks.summary: This US national historical park protects invasion beaches, guns, and ridge positions from the 1944 battle for Guam.

parks.name: Ritidian / Litekyan
parks.tagline: Northern Guam beach, limestone forest, and latte sites
parks.summary: Ritidian is a wild north-coast refuge of white sand, caves, and limestone forest at Guam's northern tip.

parks.name: American Memorial Park
parks.tagline: Saipan waterfront memorial and Micro Beach parkland
parks.summary: American Memorial Park remembers the Marianas campaign and sits beside Micro Beach in Garapan.

parks.name: Funafuti Conservation Area
parks.tagline: Uninhabited motu, turtles, and lagoon birds west of Fongafale
parks.summary: The Funafuti Conservation Area covers islets on the atoll's western rim, reached by boat for snorkelling and birdlife.

parks.name: Norfolk Island National Park
parks.tagline: Norfolk pines, Mount Pitt, and the summit of Mount Bates
parks.summary: Norfolk Island National Park protects the island's highest ridges, palms, and the walks to Mount Pitt and Mount Bates.

pois.name: Garden of the Sleeping Giant
pois.tagline: Orchid garden in a valley under the Sabeto Range

pois.name: Sri Siva Subramaniya Temple
pois.tagline: South Pacific's largest Hindu temple in Nadi

pois.name: Cloud 9 Fiji
pois.tagline: Overwater platform on the Malolo barrier reef

pois.name: Navala Village
pois.tagline: Highland vale of traditional thatched bure

pois.name: Parliament Haus
pois.tagline: National parliament with a haus-tambaran roof

pois.name: National Museum and Art Gallery
pois.tagline: PNG's main museum of culture and natural history

pois.name: Tavurvur
pois.tagline: Active Rabaul caldera cone above Blanche Bay

pois.name: Tufi
pois.tagline: Fjords and dive bays on the Cape Nelson coast

pois.name: Mele Cascades
pois.tagline: Stepped rainforest pools west of Port Vila

pois.name: Champagne Beach
pois.tagline: White-sand Santo cove with clear lagoon water

pois.name: Chief Roi Mata's Domain
pois.tagline: World Heritage chiefly landscape on Efate

pois.name: Hideaway Island
pois.tagline: Tiny reef island with an underwater post office

pois.name: Vilu War Museum
pois.tagline: Open-air WWII aircraft and guns west of Honiara

pois.name: Mataniko Falls
pois.tagline: Cave waterfall inland from Honiara

pois.name: Kennedy Island
pois.tagline: Plum Pudding Island of the PT-109 story

pois.name: Tjibaou Cultural Centre
pois.tagline: Renzo Piano pavilions for Kanak culture

pois.name: Heart of Voh
pois.tagline: Mangrove heart visible from the air on the west coast

pois.name: Kuto Bay
pois.tagline: Classic Île des Pins bay of pines and white sand

pois.name: Matira Beach
pois.tagline: Bora Bora's public white-sand point

pois.name: Cook's Bay
pois.tagline: Moorea's deep northern bay under the ridge

pois.name: Marae Taputapuatea
pois.tagline: Voyaging marae on Raiatea's southeast coast

pois.name: Point Venus
pois.tagline: Black-sand cape of Cook's transit and a lighthouse

pois.name: To Sua Ocean Trench
pois.tagline: Laddered swimming hole in a collapsed lava tube

pois.name: Piula Cave Pool
pois.tagline: Spring-fed cave swim beside a Methodist college

pois.name: Robert Louis Stevenson Museum
pois.tagline: Vailima villa below the Mount Vaea grave

pois.name: Rainmaker Mountain
pois.tagline: Cloud-catching massif above Pago Pago Harbour

pois.name: Fagatele Bay
pois.tagline: Collapsed-crater marine sanctuary on south Tutuila

pois.name: Mapu'a 'a Vaea Blowholes
pois.tagline: Coastal blowholes on Tongatapu's south shore

pois.name: Ha'amonga 'a Maui
pois.tagline: Trilithon gate of coral limestone on Tongatapu

pois.name: Wigmore's Waterfall
pois.tagline: Inland Rarotonga falls at the Cross-Island Track end

pois.name: One Foot Island
pois.tagline: Aitutaki motu with a lagoon postmark

pois.name: Limu Pools
pois.tagline: Reef pools on Niue's west coast

pois.name: Matapa Chasm

hikes.name: Lavena Coastal Walk
hikes.tagline: Village coastal path to a waterfall on eastern Taveuni
hikes.summary: The Lavena Coastal Walk follows black-sand coves, rainforest, and suspension bridges from Lavena village to a waterfall swim.
tips: Pay the village fee at the kiosk
Wear shoes that can get wet
hikes.start_instructions: Start at the Lavena visitor hut on Taveuni's east coast.

hikes.name: Mount Tomanivi
hikes.tagline: Muddy climb to Viti Levu's highest summit
hikes.summary: The Tomanivi track climbs from Navai through cloud forest to Fiji's highest peak, often in mud and mist.
tips: Hire a village guide from Navai
The track is steep and rooted
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Navai village with a local guide.

hikes.name: Colo-i-Suva Nature Trail
hikes.tagline: Short mahogany-forest circuit with swimming holes
hikes.summary: A compact network of trails links pools and lookouts inside Colo-i-Suva Forest Park near Suva.
tips: Do not leave valuables in cars
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the forest-park kiosk on the Princes Road.

hikes.name: Des Voeux Peak
hikes.tagline: 4WD-and-walk ascent to Taveuni's communications peak
hikes.summary: The Des Voeux Peak route climbs Taveuni's central ridge for island-and-reef views, often finishing in cloud.
tips: A 4WD is used for the lower road
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed mountain road south of Wairiki.

hikes.name: Varirata Lookout Walk
hikes.tagline: Sogeri-plateau forest walk to the Port Moresby lookout
hikes.summary: Short plateau trails lead to Varirata's lookout over the Astrolabe Range and the city far below.
tips: A vehicle is needed from Port Moresby
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the picnic area inside Varirata National Park.

hikes.name: Kokoda Track — Owers Corner to Imita
hikes.tagline: First steep section of the wartime Kokoda crossing
hikes.summary: From Owers Corner the Kokoda Track drops and climbs toward Imita Ridge, the usual first hard day of the historic crossing.
tips: The clay is slick after rain
hikes.start_instructions: Start at Owers Corner on the Sogeri Plateau, the southern trailhead.

hikes.name: Mount Wilhelm Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Highest summit in Papua New Guinea from Keglsugl
hikes.summary: The usual Wilhelm route climbs from Keglsugl past lakes and alpine grassland to the 4,509 m summit, often as an overnight.
tips: Start well before dawn for the summit
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Keglsugl village or the nearby lodge in Simbu Province.

hikes.name: Mount Yasur Crater Walk
hikes.tagline: Ash-plain walk to a live crater rim on Tanna
hikes.summary: A short guided walk from the ash-plain parking area leads to Yasur's crater rim for sunset eruptions.
tips: Bring a headlamp and wind layer
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the visitor parking on the ash plain below the cone.

hikes.name: Mele Cascades Walk
hikes.tagline: Stepped pools and a rainforest stair west of Port Vila
hikes.summary: A short paid walk climbs beside pools and a waterfall in a valley west of Port Vila.
tips: Go earlier to avoid tour groups
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed entrance west of Port Vila.

hikes.name: Mount Austen Walk
hikes.tagline: Ridge and wartime positions above Honiara
hikes.summary: Tracks and a road climb Mount Austen for harbour views and Guadalcanal campaign positions.
tips: A guide helps with wartime sites
Heat is strong on the ridge
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Austen road above Honiara.

hikes.name: Mataniko Falls Walk
hikes.tagline: River and cave walk to a waterfall behind Honiara
hikes.summary: A village-guided walk follows the Mataniko into a cave mouth where the river falls into a dark pool.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the inland trailhead with a Honiara guide.

hikes.name: Riviere Bleue Giant Kaori Walk
hikes.tagline: Lakeside forest walk to the drowned giant kaori
hikes.summary: A mostly flat park walk follows the drowned river and lakeshore to Rivière Bleue's famous standing kaori.
tips: The park gate has limited hours
Hire the park train or cycle the road
Look for cagou on quiet mornings
hikes.start_instructions: Start after the park gate near Pont Pérignon.

hikes.name: Mont Dore Walk
hikes.tagline: Ridge walk above the southern suburbs of Nouméa
hikes.summary: The Mont Dore track climbs a southern massif for lagoon and Grande Terre views close to Nouméa.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trailhead above Le Mont-Dore.

hikes.name: Fautaua Waterfall Walk
hikes.tagline: Permit valley walk to a high waterfall above Papeete
hikes.summary: The Fautaua track follows a locked valley from the Bain Loti area to a tall waterfall under Tahiti's interior.
tips: The river crossings rise after rain
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Bain Loti / Fautaua valley gate with a permit.

hikes.name: Aorai Trail
hikes.tagline: Knife-edge ridge toward one of Tahiti's classic peaks
hikes.summary: The Aorai trail climbs a long ridge from Fare Rau Ape with exposed sections and views over Papeete and the interior.
tips: The ridge is narrow and rooted
Carry a headlamp if starting early
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Fare Rau Ape / Belvédère road trailhead above Pirae.

hikes.name: Moorea Belvedere Walk
hikes.tagline: Short ridge paths between Cook's and Opunohu bays
hikes.summary: Walks around the Belvédère link pineapple slopes, marae, and views down both of Moorea's great northern bays.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Belvédère lookout above Opunohu Valley.

hikes.name: Mount Vaea Walk
hikes.tagline: Short steep walk to Robert Louis Stevenson's grave
hikes.summary: A steep forest path from Vailima climbs to the tomb of Robert Louis Stevenson on the summit of Mount Vaea.
tips: The track is rooted and slippery after rain
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Robert Louis Stevenson Museum at Vailima.

hikes.name: Lake Lanoto'o Walk
hikes.tagline: Muddy crater-lake walk in the hills above Apia
hikes.summary: A 4WD approach and forest walk lead to the green crater lake of Lanoto'o National Park.
tips: Guide recommended if the road is unclear
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the highland road above Apia toward the crater lake.

hikes.name: Mount Alava Adventure Trail
hikes.tagline: Ridge walk along the old tramway above Pago Pago
hikes.summary: The Mount Alava trail follows the old tramway ridge to a lookout over Pago Pago Harbour and Rainmaker Mountain.
tips: The ridge is humid and can be muddy
hikes.start_instructions: Start at Fagasa Pass on the road between Pago Pago and Fagasa.

hikes.name: 'Eua Clifftop Walk
hikes.tagline: Forest and trench-edge lookouts on 'Eua
hikes.summary: Short park and clifftop paths on 'Eua look down the Pacific trench and through the island's older forest.
tips: The ferry from Tongatapu can cancel
Birds are best in the morning
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the national-park access on 'Eua's eastern side.

hikes.name: Mount Talau Walk
hikes.tagline: Short climb to the Vava'u harbour lookout
hikes.summary: A short signed walk from Neiafu climbs Mount Talau for a view over the yacht harbour and outer islands.
tips: Go early or late for shade
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trail off the Neiafu ridge road.

hikes.name: Te Rua Manga Cross-Island Track
hikes.tagline: Muddy inland crossing past The Needle
hikes.summary: Rarotonga's Cross-Island Track climbs from the north through forest to Te Rua Manga, then drops toward Wigmore's Waterfall.
tips: The rock of The Needle is slippery
Hire a guide if the route is new to you
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Avatiu valley trailhead inland from Avarua.

hikes.name: Togo Chasm Walk
hikes.tagline: Forest and ladder descent to a hidden coral chasm
hikes.summary: A short forest boardwalk and ladder lead into Togo Chasm, a palm-filled collapse on Niue's east coast.
tips: Go at low swell if continuing to the reef
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed Togo Chasm car park on the east-coast road.

hikes.name: Ngardmau Waterfall Walk
hikes.tagline: Babeldaob forest walk to Palau's highest waterfall
hikes.summary: A muddy forest path on Babeldaob leads to Ngardmau Falls, the tallest waterfall in Palau.
tips: The track is slippery after rain
A hire car is needed from Koror
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trailhead in Ngardmau State.

hikes.name: Mount Lamlam Walk
hikes.tagline: Short climb to the highest point on Guam
hikes.summary: A short trail from the cross on Route 17 reaches Mount Lamlam, often claimed as the world's highest mountain if measured from the Marianas Trench.
tips: The trail is exposed — carry water
Snakes are present — stay on the path
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the roadside trailhead on Cross Island Road.

hikes.name: Mount Tapochau Walk
hikes.tagline: Saipan's summit lookout above the lagoon and cliffs
hikes.summary: A short road-and-path climb reaches Mount Tapochau for a full view of Saipan, Tinian, and the Philippine Sea.
tips: A high-clearance car can reach near the top
The last metres are on foot
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Tapochau road above central Saipan.

hikes.name: Sokehs Rock
hikes.tagline: Fixed-rope basalt climb above Pohnpei harbour
hikes.summary: Sokehs Rock is a short, steep climb with ropes and roots to a prow of basalt above Kolonia.
tips: The rock is slick in rain
Go with someone who knows the start
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the trail behind Sokehs village, north-west of Kolonia.

hikes.name: Mount Pitt Walk
hikes.tagline: Pine-forest walk to Norfolk's second summit
hikes.summary: A short national-park walk climbs through Norfolk pines and palms to the Mount Pitt lookout.
tips: The road also reaches a lookout
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the national-park road or the lower walking track on Norfolk Island.
